name: Cold Ice Strike
body:
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 211
School evocation [cold]; Level arcanist 6, cleric 6, occultist 6, oracle 6, sorcerer 6, warpriest 6, wizard 6
Casting
Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S
Effect
Range 30 ft.
Area 30-ft. line
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes
Description
You create a shredding flurry of ice slivers, which blast from your hand in a line. The line deals 1d6 points of cold damage per caster level (maximum 15d6).
